issue_context.title: JSRuntime: AssertionError false == true

review_comments: Could we change the loader API to accept multiple bundles? I believe `importScripts` blocks execution, but can take variadic arguments (`importScripts(bundle1, bundle2, bundle3)`), so we could download them in parallel.
